Antonelli Championship Math — 66 Clear, Singapore the Clinch Window
**[HIGH confidence]**
- Antonelli leads 2026 Drivers' Championship with 302 pts [motorsport.com, gpfans.com standings]
- Russell 2nd with 236 pts — gap 66 pts [same sources]
- Hamilton 3rd with 199 pts [same sources]
- Norris 4th with 186 pts [same sources]
- Leclerc 5th with 179 pts [same sources]
- Verstappen 6th with 163 pts [standings after Azerbaijan]
- 8 rounds remaining (Rounds 16–23) [standings sources]
- Mercedes Constructors: 538 pts [story-history.md 2026-09-27]
- Singapore GP: Oct 9-11, Round 17 of 23 [story-history.md + official F1]
- Singapore is first-ever Sprint format at Marina Bay [singaporegp.sg]
- Sprint worth maximum 8 points [formula1.com]
- Antonelli started P16 at Baku (qualifying crash), finished P5 [story-history.md 2026-09-27]
**[MEDIUM confidence]**
- Youngest champion if clinched at Singapore: 20y2m8d — breaks Vettel 2010 record by ~3 years [story-history.md note; not independently verified]
**Championship clinch math:**
- Max Russell can score from Rounds 17–23 (7 races): 7 × 26 = 182 pts + no further sprints
- For Antonelli to clinch at Singapore (Round 17): need post-Singapore lead > 182 pts
- Current lead: 66 pts — cannot clinch AT Singapore even in perfect scenario
- Singapore is the "statement" weekend — Antonelli extending lead to ~80+ pts would be significant
